title: introduce-go-ci-bootstrap-and-dep-thermostat
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: Reduce presubmit latency and flakiness by replacing a collection of fragile bash/bootstrap scripts with a compact, hermetic Go binary (ci-bootstrap) and introduce a lightweight dependency health monitor (dep-thermostat) to control devdep churn. Goals: 1) speed up dev feedback for common edits by introducing a fast 'lite' presubmit lane and a secondary full presubmit lane; 2) reduce transient failures caused by transitive devdeps and inconsistent lockfiles; 3) make release sanity checks explicit and cheap. Changes included: a) new Go-based ci-bootstrap shipped under tools/ci-bootstrap with a small config format and compatibility wrapper for legacy scripts; b) dep-thermostat service (CLI mode) that scans package manifests, flags transitive devdep churn and offers an automated pin suggestion that gets authored as a branch; c) presubmit pipeline split: `.github/workflows/presubmit-lite.yml` for quick static checks and fast unit subsets, `.github/workflows/presubmit-full.yml` for full integration tests; d) moved -ci Docker builder to use reproducible tarball cache keys and deterministic build args; e) added migration script scripts/migrate-lockfiles.ts to refresh lockfiles in staged mode; f) updated developer docs at docs/dev/ci.md describing new workflow and rollback steps. Checklist: - [x] implement Go bootstrap binary and CLI flags - [x] compatibility wrapper and README - [x] presubmit-lite and presubmit-full workflows - [x] dep-thermostat initial heuristics and CLI - [x] migration script and lockfile smoke runs - [x] e2e smoke on a representative module; Related: Linear ENG-2312 (presubmit performance), ENG-2401 (dep hygiene). Notes: this PR intentionally keeps the Go binary minimal (no external network by default), uses existing caching primitives and respects team-level toolchain manifests; the dep-thermostat is gated behind a feature flag and only writes automated pin branches when CI smoke passes.

review_comments: Luca Moretti: Nice approach. Please add a short benchmark (cold and warm) for bootstrap latency; also ensure the Go binary exits with code 0 when run in dry-run mode.
Maya Thompson (author): Added micro-benchmarks under tools/ci-bootstrap/bench and implemented dry-run exit behavior. See commit 3m4n5o.
Anika Patel: dep-thermostat heuristic seems aggressive for large repos; can we make the threshold configurable and off by default? Also request tests for transitive-dep detection.
Maya Thompson (author): Threshold is now configurable via DEP_THERMOSTAT_THRESHOLD env var and default is 0.05; added unit tests and a small fixture repository for CI.
Josef Reinhart: The compatibility wrapper is important for on-prem customers; please add a note in docs about rollback and how to opt-out of the new presubmit-lite lane.
Maya Thompson (author): docs/dev/ci.md updated with rollback steps and opt-out instructions.
release_notes: Introduce Go-based ci-bootstrap to reduce presubmit latency; add dep-thermostat for devdep churn detection; split presubmit into lite and full lanes; add lockfile migration helper; improve reproducible CI Docker builds. No user-facing API changes.
